name: com.modernwestern.observer-vm
description:
Zero-allocation, strongly typed MVVM bindings for Unity UI (UGUI + TextMeshPro), inspired by Unreal's UMG.
Views derive from Widget<TViewModel>, ViewModels expose Observable<T> properties and Commands, and bindings are declared once with Bind.Text, Bind.Value, Bind.Click...

samples.description: A ready-to-play scene: a player HUD (Widget prefab) bound to a PlayerViewModel with text, a health bar, a two-way volume slider and mute toggle, and Hit/Respawn commands. Works with the legacy Input Manager and the Input System package. Requires TextMeshPro (import TMP Essential Resources when prompted).
